document_notes: Page 164 of PIR contains one entry (851) that explicitly matches the criteria for the PROVINCIA corpus (legatus Aug. pr. pr. of Cappadocia). Entry 849 mentions 'legatus pr. pr. provinciae Africae', which refers to a legatus proconsulis in a senatorial province, not a legatus Augusti pro praetore, and is therefore excluded.
